seoDescription: Magenta Midnight Bloom blouse with gold Aari sprigs and navy beadwork. Pair with magenta, navy or gold sarees. Listed at ₹4,499; timing by enquiry.
seoCopy: Magenta Midnight Bloom brings together a rich magenta base, fine gold sprig embroidery, navy floral accents and puff sleeves. The listed work is Aari-style embroidery with floral motifs and beadwork; exact fibre and bead composition can be confirmed during your enquiry. On the front, radiating gold-toned details frame a broad rounded neckline, with matching borders along the sleeves and hem. A magenta or wine saree creates a tonal look, while navy, midnight blue, cream or gold can pick up the contrasting motifs. Choose with the saree's zari, border and jewellery in view, and ask to discuss motif placement or colour adjustments before work begins. The listed starting price is ₹4,499 for embroidery on a customer-supplied blouse or garment. The garment, courier and any material changes beyond the displayed design are quoted separately. Provide your event date and garment readiness so the studio can assess the brief and confirm a feasible schedule against current workload.
summary: A rich magenta blouse with delicate gold sprig embroidery, navy floral accents and puff sleeves.
description: The front design features a broad rounded neckline with radiating gold-toned motifs, small navy floral accents and matching embroidered borders along the sleeves and hem. The back carries the same colour palette and decorative language, with a U-shaped neckline, tie strings and paired tassels. Puff sleeves and the rich magenta base give the blouse a soft, romantic silhouette.

specs.timeline: About 14–21 days once your brief and advance are confirmed

priceIncludes: Hand embroidery work on the customer-supplied blouse or garment, including the design consultation and the work shown in the listed design.
priceExcludes: The blouse/garment itself, courier outside Trichy (delivery within Trichy is free), and any extra material changes beyond the listed design are quoted separately.
shippingNote: The customer sends the blouse or saree by courier to the studio; the completed piece is returned by tracked delivery after the embroidery is finished.

faqs.q: What occasion is Magenta Midnight Bloom best for?
faqs.a: Engagements, baby showers, festive functions and wedding guest looks. The puff sleeves and navy floral accents give a soft, romantic feel.

faqs.q: Which sarees go well with Magenta Midnight Bloom?
faqs.a: Magenta or wine silk for a tonal look, or navy, midnight blue, cream or gold silk to pick up the floral accents. A saree border that repeats one of these colours ties it together.

faqs.q: Does the design need puff sleeves?
faqs.a: No. The motifs can be placed on straight, elbow-length or short sleeves. Let us know your sleeve style and we will adapt the border to it.

faqs.q: Can you change the colours or motifs on Magenta Midnight Bloom?
faqs.a: Yes. Most brides change something: the thread colour to match their saree, a denser or lighter fill, or a different neckline and sleeve finish. Send your saree photo on WhatsApp and we will tell you what works and whether it changes the price.

faqs.q: How do I order Magenta Midnight Bloom?
faqs.a: Tap WhatsApp or Make It Yours and send your saree photo and event date. We confirm the design, price, courier charge and delivery date. You pay a 50% advance, courier your blouse to our Trichy studio, and we send it back by tracked courier once the work is done.
